name: Radial KPI Progress Gauge
description: Multi-tier concentric progress rings inspired by Apple Fitness and cloud quota meters with smooth arc animations, customizable goal thresholds, and central metric readouts.

name: Calendar Activity Heatmap
description: 53-week rolling calendar activity grid inspired by GitHub contribution graphs, with quantile color scaling, day-of-week/month axes, interactive hover cards, and peak metric summaries.

name: Stephen Few Bullet Graph
description: Executive KPI performance bullet graph implementing Stephen Few's classic specification with multi-tier qualitative range bands, target/quota markers, variance badges, and hover details.

fields_required.measures: 1 to 3 (Actual required; Target/Goal and Baseline optional)

name: Dumbbell Divergence Plot
description: Executive dumbbell and connected dot plot designed for variance analysis, period-over-period comparisons (2024 vs 2025), target vs actuals, and range divergence across categories with directional chevrons and variance pills.

fields_required.measures: 1 to 2 Measures (Baseline/Start and Comparison/End), or 1 pivoted measure (2 pivots)

name: Interactive US Choropleth Map
description: Pure SVG 50-state US choropleth heatmap with Albers USA projection, quantile color scaling, automatic state name & postal code parsing, hover elevation, and Looker drill-down links.

name: Sparkline Metric Matrix Table
description: Executive scorecard table featuring in-cell SVG trend sparklines with shaded gradient fills, micro bullet bars, period growth percentage badges, and client-side search filtering.

name: Player & Customer Retention Cohort Decay
description: Multi-mode retention cohort decay matrix and interactive D3 Bézier curve visualization for gaming telemetry (D1/D7/D30 player retention) and SaaS lifecycle analytics with dynamic Period 0 indexing (100%), benchmark outperformance variance, and dual synchronized split view.

fields_required.dimensions: 1 Cohort Dimension (e.g. users.created_month) + 1 Activity Period Dimension (e.g. order_items.created_month) OR 1 Pivot
fields_required.measures: 1 Numeric Measure (e.g. order_items.order_count or users count)

name: Broadcast Programming Schedule & Daypart Performance Grid
description: Multi-mode 7-day x 24-hour programming schedule and Nielsen daypart performance grid for television, streaming, ad-ops pacing, and diurnal retail conversion analytics with peak anomaly detection, marginal rollups, and interactive diurnal spline curves.

fields_required.dimensions: 2 Dimensions: Day of Week (e.g. ad_spot_airings.airing_day_of_week) + Hour of Day (e.g. ad_spot_airings.airing_hour_of_day) [Optional 3rd Dimension for Slicing, e.g. broadcast_programming.network]

name: Network Topology & Latency Flow Graph
description: Interactive multi-modal network topology, packet flow, and transmission latency graph designed for telecommunications, cell tower networks, cloud infrastructure, and microservice meshes. Features D3 physics force-directed layout, hierarchical concentric radial tiers, circular peering chord ring, and adjacency latency matrix with real-time packet pulse flow animations, bottleneck detection, neighbor node focus, and Looker drill-down.

fields_required.dimensions: 1 to 2 Dimensions: Source Node (e.g. distribution_centers.name) + Target Node (e.g. users.state)
fields_required.measures: 1 to 3 Measures: Volume/Throughput (e.g. order_items.total_sale_price), Latency/Delay (e.g. order_items.average_shipping_time), Packet Count (e.g. order_items.order_count)

name: Sankey Flow & Multi-Stage Allocation Diagram
description: Interactive multi-mode Sankey flow, alluvial attribution, and hierarchical breakdown diagram for e-commerce conversions, marketing multi-touch attribution, financial cost allocations, and telemetry packet paths with draggable nodes, Bézier ribbons, path search, and Looker drill-down.

fields_required.dimensions: 2 to 8 Dimensions representing sequential stages (e.g. Origin -> Intermediate -> Destination)
fields_required.measures: 1 to 2 Measures: Flow Volume / Value (e.g. Total Sales, Units, Traffic) and optional secondary measure

name: Rank Bump & Trajectory Chart
description: Interactive multi-mode rank bump chart and trajectory tracker for competitive leaderboards, product category market share shifts, and customer segment volatility over time with smooth cubic Bézier curves, net rank shift delta badges (+2, -1), executive KPI HUD, and Looker drill-down.

fields_required.pivots: 1 Chronological Pivot (e.g. order_items.created_month) OR 2-12 chronological measures

name: Geospatial Flow & Route Arc Map
description: Interactive multi-mode geospatial flow, supply chain route, and flight path map with Bézier great-circle curved arcs, animated 60fps glowing flow pulses, hub-and-spoke radial topologies, client-side hexbin spatial density clustering, origin hub isolation, Top-N density filtering, and Looker drill-down integration.

fields_required.dimensions: 1 to 2 Dimensions: Origin Hub (e.g. distribution_centers.name) + Destination (e.g. users.state) [Optional Origin/Dest Lat/Long coordinates]
fields_required.measures: 1 to 3 Measures: Flow Volume (e.g. order_items.total_sale_price) + optional Latency/Transit Time and Order Count

name: Telemetry & Conversion Funnel
description: Interactive multi-mode conversion funnel, drop-off pipeline, and telemetry flow visualization for gaming FTUE progression, e-commerce checkout conversion, and product onboarding with continuous Bézier fluid stream ribbons, stepped trapezoids, waterfall drop-off deltas, executive KPI HUD, and Looker drill-down integration.

fields_required.dimensions: 1 to 2 Dimensions: Stage Dimension (e.g. order_items.status) + optional Segment/Channel (e.g. users.traffic_source) OR 2-8 measures
fields_required.measures: 1 to 2 Measures: Throughput Volume (e.g. order_items.order_count) + optional Secondary Metric (e.g. order_items.total_sale_price)

name: Collapsible Hierarchical Tree Grid
description: Executive collapsible hierarchical tree grid solving Looker Cloud Blocker b/530833873 and go/prd-looker-table-viz-improvements. Consolidates nested multi-level hierarchies into a single indented column with interactive branch expansion, dynamic subtotal rollups, in-cell share progress bars, branch search, and Looker drill menus.

fields_required.dimensions: 2 to 6 Dimensions (Hierarchy Levels, e.g. Department > Category > Brand)
fields_required.measures: 1 to 4 Numeric Measures (e.g. Sales, Orders, Profit)

name: Dual-Axis Multi-Layer Geospatial Map
description: Enterprise dual-axis multi-layer geospatial visualization solving Looker Cloud Blocker b/243984441 and go/prd-looker-map-viz-improvements. Plots two independent measures simultaneously across geographic regions with Layer 1 choropleth polygon fill, Layer 2 proportional centroid bubble pins, dual legends, equal-area hex cartogram mode, executive KPI HUD, and Looker drill-down integration.

fields_required.dimensions: 1 Geographic Dimension (State Name, Postal Code, or FIPS)
fields_required.measures: 1 to 3 Numeric Measures: Primary (Choropleth Fill), Secondary (Bubble Size), Tertiary

name: Multivariate Radar & Polar Balance Chart
description: Enterprise multivariate radar and polar balance chart solving Looker Cloud Blockers b/453718648, b/184359819, and go/agentrics-docs-spider-chart. Features 4 multi-modal rendering layouts (polygon web, rose coxcomb, radial lollipop bars, small multiples grid), independent spoke max and benchmark median normalization, client-side rollups for 5,000+ rows, 2 clean option tabs (Display and Style), interactive entity isolation, and Looker drill-downs.
